modules.name: shodan_ip
modules.description: Uses the Shodan API to find contacts associated with a specified IP address, including email addresses and other identifying information.

modules.name: github_dorks
modules.description: Searches GitHub for exposed credentials, API keys, and sensitive information using dork queries against public repositories.

modules.name: whois_poc
modules.description: Performs WHOIS lookups on domains to identify the point of contact (POC) including registrant name, organization, email, and phone numbers.

modules.name: linkedin_search
modules.description: Searches LinkedIn for employee profiles associated with a target organization, useful for social engineering reconnaissance.

modules.name: virustotal_domain
modules.description: Queries VirusTotal for domain reports including passive DNS, resolved IPs, and malware detections associated with the domain.

modules.name: haveibeenpwned
modules.description: Checks if email addresses have been compromised in known data breaches using the Have I Been Pwned API.
